title.en: Attentive salon staff and loyal groomers

text.en: Clients frequently commend salon owner Donna and staff members like Maddie, Melissa, Jeff, and Cameron for their warm and knowledgeable customer care. Reviewers emphasize that the front desk remembers returning pets by name and provides timely pickup notifications. Staff members are praised for their genuine dedication to pet welfare.

title.en: Consistent breed cuts and fresh coats

text.en: Pet owners report excellent grooming outcomes, noting that their dogs return looking well-groomed, smelling clean, and trimmed according to breed standards. Reviewers who have visited for multiple years praise the consistency of the washes, hair styling, and teeth cleaning. Groomers handle small breeds like Shih Tzus with particular skill.

title.en: Engaging daycare and pet boarding care

text.en: Many clients rely on the salon for dog daycare and overnight boarding, sharing that their dogs enjoy social play and return home cheerful and tired. The team is known to care for rescue dogs and treat visiting pets like family. However, one critical review complained about loud barking and synthetic turf odors in the indoor play area.

q.en: What services are offered at the Galleria salon?

a.en: The facility provides full dog grooming, bath and haircut packages, dog daycare playgroups, and overnight pet boarding.

q.en: How are owners notified when grooming is finished?

a.en: Reviewers state that the front desk staff calls or texts promptly once a dog is ready for pickup to prevent unnecessary crate waiting.

q.en: Does the salon groom specific or difficult breeds?

a.en: Yes, clients mention skilled cuts for a variety of breeds including Shih Tzus, doodles, and rescue dogs requiring specialized coat care.
